D: Two lifelong mates start a revenge-for-hire business to raise money for a heart operation.
P: Serve the mains when Mitch and Sam open Dirty Work for business.
S: Hot chicken wings tossed in a buttery hot sauce with blue cheese dip, payback with a kick. Bake the wings until crisp first.
Mitch losing one job after another
A mixed box of pretzels, peanuts and cheese crackers, the kind of snacks you grab on the way out of yet another job.
M: Pops, Sam's dad, who needs the operation
A patty melt on rye with Swiss cheese and fried onions, old-school diner food Pops would order.
W: a good day for a change
Vanilla ice cream with hot fudge, peanuts and a cherry, the kind of treat you have when the plan finally works.
K: Ice-cold lager in the bottle, the kind Pops would crack open. Lemonade for the kids.

s.how: Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once. Toss in 100ml hot sauce melted with 50g butter. Serve with 100g blue cheese stirred into 150g sour cream.

s.note: Mitch losing one job after another
s.how: Tip 150g pretzels, 200g salted peanuts and 150g cheese crackers into a big box or bowl and toss together. Serve straight away on the coffee table before the film starts.

m.note: Pops, Sam's dad, who needs the operation
m.how: Slowly fry 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 20 minutes. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and cook 3 minutes a side. Layer each on buttered rye with Swiss cheese and onions and fry until golden and melted.

w.note: a good day for a change
w.how: Scoop 1L vanilla ice cream into 4 bowls. Pour over warm chocolate topping, scatter with 50g chopped peanuts and top each with a cherry. Serve straight away.

d.how: Chill 8 bottles of lager in an esky full of ice for an hour. Serve in the bottle with cold lemonade for anyone not drinking. Keep a second round ready for the back half.
